create_Flux2FinetunedPipelineConfig: create a Flux2FinetunedPipelineConfig instance for fine-tuned Flux VAE models with patchified latents
preprocess_decoding_latents: preprocess 4D or 5D latent tensors for VAE decoding with automatic unpatchify for standard Flux2 VAEs
get_decode_scale_and_shift: get dynamic scale and shift factors for decoding based on whether the VAE uses BatchNorm
handle_5D_latents: handle 5D latent tensors by squeezing single-frame cases or flattening multi-frame batches for decoding
detect_vae_type: detect whether a VAE uses BatchNorm to choose between standard and distilled decoding parameters
